Elaine — appreciate the clear list. I pulled together a concise commercial response and an attached term sheet (EnterpriseBank_RFP_Section6_Response.pdf) plus a spreadsheet with the price math. High level summary below; full details in attachments.

- List pricing (per 1,000 tokens): prompt $0.0040 / 1K, completion $0.0090 / 1K. Embeddings (64-d) $0.0100 / 1K units. Rerank/other specialized ops priced case-by-case.
- Commit discounts (annualized): 250M tokens: 12% discount off list; 1B tokens: 24% discount; 2.5B tokens: 36% discount. Discounts apply to combined prompt+completion usage.
- Monthly true-up: commits are annual but invoiced monthly as 'committed monthly amount' (annual commit / 12). Unused committed tokens can roll forward quarter-to-quarter up to a 90-day carry window; unspent tokens beyond 90 days expire.
- Overage: metered at 1K-token granularity, billed monthly. Overage rate = list price * (1 - commit_discount * 0.6). Example: at 24% commit discount, overage = list * (1 - 0.144) => roughly 85.6% of list. We provide a hard cap on overage of list price (never above list). For very bursty patterns we can add a temporary surge allowance at commit-rate pricing for up to 10% of monthly commit.
- Minimums & termination: standard 12-month commitment. Early termination triggers a pro-rated true-up (remaining committed value less credits for usage to-date), or the option to pay an exit fee equal to 25% of remaining committed dollars.

I've cc'd Rishi and Laura for legal/ops confirmation. If those guardrails look good, I'll prepare a redline-friendly term sheet and we can route the procurement template you attached.
